question_text: I was born in the Shire in 2980. My eldest daughter was named Elanor. I carried a burden I never wore, and a master I did.
answer_text: Samwise Gamgee -- Ring-bearer for a time in Mordor; later Mayor of the Shire.

question_text: Under a borrowed name I once captained the Steward's ships. As a boy I was called Hope, and never told my line. I walked the Paths of the Dead and took a crown in the White City.
answer_text: Aragorn, son of Arathorn -- Served Ecthelion as Thorongil; raised as Estel; crowned King Elessar.

question_text: In the Undying Lands I walked in gardens of dreams under another name. A shipwright gave me a ring of fire. I fell with a demon from a bridge and returned in white.
answer_text: Gandalf the Grey (and White) -- Olorin in Valinor; Cirdan gave him Narya; returned after Durin's Bridge.

question_text: I was too young to march with my father against a dragon. I asked a lady for one hair and was given three. At Helm's Deep I won a counting game by one.
answer_text: Gimli -- Galadriel gave Gimli three hairs; won the tally 42 to 41.

question_text: My twin chose to die as a Man; I chose the other path. I am a master of healing. In my house a council decided the fate of the Ring.
answer_text: Elrond Half-elven -- Twin of Elros; bearer of Vilya; host of the Council at Rivendell.

question_text: Twice ten circles, round and bright, in holly-land the smiths wrought right; a guest with fair face taught the art -- and hid a master in his heart.
answer_text: The Rings of Power -- Twenty in all: three, seven, nine and the One forged by Sauron in Orodruin.

question_text: Water caught a wanderer's flame; a crystal keeps it, cold and tame. Lift me high in a reeking lair and eight-legged hunger fears the glare.
answer_text: The Phial of Galadriel -- It holds the light of Earendil's star; Frodo and Sam used it against Shelob.

question_text: Delved, not grown; I own no sky. Truesilver made me rich, then cursed; the eldest father woke me first -- my bridge is narrow, the drop is high.
answer_text: Moria -- Khazad-dum -- The Dwarrowdelf; the Elves named it the Black Chasm after the Balrog woke.

question_text: I praised a waistcoat, jewelled and fine; a guest of riddles flattered, and lied. A thrush bore word of what I hid -- the lake took me, and all my pride.
answer_text: Smaug -- The bare patch on his left breast; Bard's Black Arrow found it over Lake-town.

question_text: I speak in plurals, though I'm one; my birthday gift was bought with blood. Beneath the roots I lost the sun -- and danced, at last, in fire's flood.
answer_text: Smeagol / Gollum -- He was fishing from a boat with Deagol when the Ring was found on his birthday.

question_text: THE SHIRE -- Which river forms the eastern boundary of the Shire?
answer_text: The Brandywine -- Elvish Baranduin. The Brandybucks took their name from it.

question_text: MORIA -- Name the stairs which connects the lowest depths of Moria all the way to its peak.
MIRKWOOD -- By what name was this forest known before the Shadow came?
ROHAN -- The natural lowland corridor between the Misty Mountains & the White Mountains.
GONDOR -- Minas Tirith was built under a different name. What was it called?
MORDOR -- Name the two ways by which the Ring-bearer could have entered Mordor from the west.
answer_text: The Morannon (the Black Gate) and the pass of Cirith Ungol.

question_text: RIVENDELL -- Give the name of the river whose flood swept away the Nine at its ford.
MISTY MOUNTAINS -- The Fellowship first tried to cross the mountains by a high pass. Name the peak that defeated them.
DURIN'S FOLK 100 -- Who is Gimli's father, one of Thorin's company?
DURIN'S FOLK 200 -- Which dragon drove the Dwarves out of Erebor?
DURIN'S FOLK 300 -- Who became King under the Mountain after Thorin fell?
DURIN'S FOLK 400 -- He was the eldest of the seven fathers of the Dwarves created by Aule.
DURIN'S FOLK 500 -- Which dying Dwarf gave Gandalf the map and key of Erebor, and where?
answer_text: Thrain II, in the pits of Dol Guldur.

question_text: HOBBIT-LORE 100 -- What is the name of Bilbo's home beneath the Hill in Hobbiton?
HOBBIT-LORE 200 -- Which inn at Bree is kept by Barliman Butterbur?
HOBBIT-LORE 300 -- What false name did Frodo travel under when he reached Bree?
HOBBIT-LORE 400 -- How old was Bilbo at his farewell party -- and what did hobbits call that age?
HOBBIT-LORE 500 -- Name the last battle of the War of the Ring, fought in the Shire itself.
ARMS & ARTEFACTS 100 -- Name the sword reforged in Rivendell from the shards of Narsil.
ARMS & ARTEFACTS 200 -- Name Bilbo's short blade, which glowed blue when Orcs drew near.
ARMS & ARTEFACTS 300 -- Name the seeing-stone Pippin stole a look into at Dol Baran.
ARMS & ARTEFACTS 400 -- Name Gandalf's sword from the trolls' hoard, which the Orcs called Beater.
ARMS & ARTEFACTS 500 -- Name the green stone Galadriel gave Aragorn, from which he took a royal name.
BEASTS OF THE DARK 100 -- What kind of creature was Shelob?
BEASTS OF THE DARK 200 -- Which horse, chief of the Mearas, would bear only Gandalf?
BEASTS OF THE DARK 300 -- Which Eagle bore Gandalf away from the pinnacle of Orthanc?
BEASTS OF THE DARK 400 -- What seized Frodo outside the West-gate of Moria?
BEASTS OF THE DARK 500 -- Name the ancient mother from whom Shelob descended.
ELVEN-KIND 100 -- Member of the Fellowship.
ELVEN-KIND 200 -- Lady of Lothlorien.
ELVEN-KIND 300 -- Daughter of Elrond.
ELVEN-KIND 400 -- Elf-lord who set Frodo on his horse Asfaloth.
ELVEN-KIND 500 -- Noldorin Elf who forged the Silmarils.
WIZARDS & MAIAR 100 -- The original White Wizard.
WIZARDS & MAIAR 200 -- Servant of Aule the Smith, then Morgoth.
WIZARDS & MAIAR 300 -- Wizard of Rhosgobel is a friend to birds and beasts.
WIZARDS & MAIAR 400 -- Which Maia, wife of King Thingol of Doriath, was the mother of Luthien?
WIZARDS & MAIAR 500 -- Name the two Blue Wizards who went into the East.
WORDS & TONGUES 100 -- 'Speak, friend, and enter' -- which Elvish word opened the West-gate of Moria?
WORDS & TONGUES 200 -- In which language is the inscription on the One Ring written?
answer_text: The Black Speech of Mordor, in Elvish letters.

question_text: WORDS & TONGUES 300 -- What does Gandalf's Elvish name 'Mithrandir' mean?
WORDS & TONGUES 400 -- A slow unhurried, repetitive language spoken, where a single word can be long & rambling.
WORDS & TONGUES 500 -- The universal language of Men & Hobbits.
KINGS OF MEN 100 -- King of Rohan under Saruman's spell.
KINGS OF MEN 200 -- Steward of Gondor burned himself on a pyre during the siege of Minas Tirith.
KINGS OF MEN 300 -- Cut the One Ring from Sauron's hand at the end of the Last Alliance.
answer_text: Isildur, with the shard of Narsil.

question_text: KINGS OF MEN 400 -- Rode from the North to win the Field of Celebrant and founded the realm of Rohan.
KINGS OF MEN 500 -- Last King of Gondor before Aragorn.
